tagline: Identity, authentication and authorization for AI agents: agent IDs, delegated OAuth, credential brokers, workload identity and policy.
scope: It is about identity or access for AI agents, not a general identity product with no agent story.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: agent cubes queue on a lane toward a gate, each hands its badge to a reader that shows a check and lifts the barrier so it can enter a vault, while one agent with no badge gets a red cross and turns back.
